customer_message.subject: Request for help contesting termination of my lease at Rosenstrasse 38, Baden
customer_message.body: Dear Claims Team, I am writing to ask for your help contesting the termination of my lease for the 3.5-room flat at Rosenstrasse 38 in Baden. The landlord is Regimo Liegenschaften AG. The flat is our family home: my husband lives there with me. The landlord is ending the tenancy because of unpaid rent. He states that the arrears amount to about CHF 5,280. I dispute that the termination is justified on this basis, and I believe it is retaliation. Earlier this year I complained in writing about defects in the flat, including damp in the bathroom and a faulty heating valve, and I also challenged the rent increase. Shortly after that, the landlord started raising the arrears issue. I would like your legal expenses cover to review the termination and advise me on the steps available to challenge it, including contesting it with the conciliation authority. Please tell me which documents you need from me, and whether a lawyer from your panel can take the case. Thank you for your prompt reply. Kind regards, Dana Pierce, phone +41 56 555 01 23
